collection.title: Peugeot 207 CC 2006 to 2012 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Peugeot 207 CC 2006 to 2011 model which requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 17" for the passengers side. This model uses the Side Pin arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
